# Vermont Comforts of Home

> A non-profit Adult Family Care program in Vermont, run jointly by Upper Valley Services, Inc. (Essex Junction, 802-662-5978) and Lincoln Street, Inc. (Springfield, 802-886-1833). It provides shared living and care coordination under Vermont's Choices for Care initiative, so adults who need a nursing-home level of care can live in a home in their community instead. The site is available in English and Nepali.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.vtcomfortsofhome.org/): what the program is, who it serves, and the counties covered.
- [Participants](https://www.vtcomfortsofhome.org/participants.html): care coordination, shared living, who qualifies, cost (Medicaid; about $826.65/month toward room and board), and how placement works.
- [Home Care Providers](https://www.vtcomfortsofhome.org/home-care-providers.html): becoming a paid home care provider — responsibilities, requirements, stipend and support. Vermont now allows payment to adult children caring for their parents.
- [About](https://www.vtcomfortsofhome.org/about.html): values, services, and the staff of both partner agencies.
- [Contact](https://www.vtcomfortsofhome.org/contact.html): office addresses, phone numbers and a contact form.

## Service area

Upper Valley Services: Chittenden, Franklin, Grand Isle, Lamoille, Caledonia, Washington and Orange counties.
Lincoln Street, Inc.: Addison, Rutland, Windsor, Windham and Bennington counties.
Essex and Orleans counties: referral / partner area.
